expectations.text: Should check submodule tree_commit vs head_commit vs remote_commit with graceful fallback
expectations.evidence: 三个 commit 逐个给出: "✅ standards: 与远程同步 (tree==remote cc864ee, behind 0)" 与 "ℹ️ standards: workdir bb5d375 ≠ gitlink cc864ee (在 feature 分支上, 有意)"; 表头含 `tree_vs_remote` / `workdir_vs_tree` / `behind_count` / `ahead_count`; 无法解析的比较降级: "原因: no_local_tracking_ref ... 判定: evidence_grade=fresh ⇒ 良性 unknown"

expectations.text: Should detect submodule drift when tree_vs_remote is true and recommend git submodule update --remote
expectations.evidence: 推荐规则 `submodule_drift` (priority 1.97) 的触发条件是 `tree_vs_remote == true` **且** `behind_count > 0` **两者同时成立** —— 当前一条都不满足, **规则未触发**, 所以本次扫描不会给你任何 `git submodule update --remote` 的建议

expectations.text: Should NOT execute git fetch without user consent (read FETCH_HEAD age instead)
expectations.evidence: remote_refresh 8/8 leg 本轮 fetch 成功 @ 2026-09-05T23:07 (skipped_remotes=[]; sync_status.remote_refs_age="1m" 是 DEPRECATED 字段, 它只反映本次 scan 自己刚做的 fetch, 不作为陈旧度判据) —— 本轮确实执行了 fetch 且无用户确认环节, 并显式否定 FETCH_HEAD age 作判据

expectations.text: Should gracefully handle missing origin/HEAD via four-tier fallback (origin_HEAD -> ls-remote -> config_default -> unavailable)
expectations.evidence: 全文无 origin_HEAD / ls-remote / config_default / unavailable / remote_commit_source / 四级回退 字样 (grep 零命中); 仅有多远程 parity 的 "原因: no_local_tracking_ref — 分支 feature/m6-cost-model-telemetry 未推 github 镜像", 不是断言要求的四级 fallback
